intro: There’s something incredibly soothing about this square cushion cover. Its soft gradient feels like a warm hug, bringing a sense of calm and cozy warmth into your living space.

features.title: Polished, perfect, never fades
features.text: Made from breathable, high-quality cotton, this cushion cover offers exceptional softness and durability for everyday use.

features.title: Timeless design, easy to wear
features.text: Its neutral yet artistic gradient blends effortlessly with a variety of styles and color schemes, enhancing any room effortlessly.

features.title: Timeless quality undeniable craftsmanship
features.text: Skillfully stitched with attention to detail, the cover reflects fine craftsmanship that ensures a polished and elegant finish.

care: Dry clean recommended or gentle hand wash with mild detergent and cold water. Wash separately to prevent color bleeding. Do not tumble dry. Do not bleach. Dry inside out in shade. Do not iron.
